ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, the outside is a square, and a small segment near the right on the top is labeled 1/n. Four line segments connect from the vertices of the square to division points on the opposite sides near the opposite vertices: two lines have positive slope and are parallel to each other, and the other two lines have negative slope and are parallel to each other; they enclose a small square in the center. Reasoning: The area of the outer square is 1, so the side length is 1. Let its four vertices be (0,0), (1,0), (1,1), (0,1). According to the label in the figure, one group of parallel lines with positive slope can be taken as the line passing through (0,0) and (1-1/n,1), and the line passing through (1/n,0) and (1,1). Their slopes are both n/(n-1), and the equations can be written as nx-(n-1)y=0 and nx-(n-1)y-1=0. Therefore the distance between these two parallel lines is 1/sqrt(n^2+(n-1)^2). One group of parallel lines with negative slope has slope -(n-1)/n, is perpendicular to the group with positive slope, and the distance between the corresponding parallel lines is the same, so the central figure is a small square with side length 1/sqrt(n^2+(n-1)^2). Its area is 1/(n^2+(n-1)^2). The problem gives the area as 1/1985, so n^2+(n-1)^2=1985. Simplifying gives 2n^2-2n+1=1985, that is, n^2-n-992=0. Since 992=32×31, n=32 or n=-31; n is a positive integer, so n=32.

method.method_draft: Use analytic geometry. From the image, take the outer square as a unit square with the marked top-right segment length 1/n, and note the four drawn segments form two pairs of parallel lines enclosing the small central square. Put coordinates on the outer square, e.g. bottom-left (0,0), bottom-right (1,0), top-right (1,1), top-left (0,1). The positive-slope lines are through (0,0) and (1-1/n,1), and through (1/n,0) and (1,1). Their slope is n/(n-1), and their perpendicular separation is computed from their line equations. The negative-slope pair has slope -(n-1)/n, so the two families are perpendicular; therefore the central parallelogram is a square and its side length is the distance between either parallel pair. This distance is 1/sqrt(n^2+(n-1)^2), so the area is 1/(n^2+(n-1)^2). Set this equal to 1/1985 and solve n^2+(n-1)^2=1985, giving n=32.
